title: Lissity under finite étale pushforward
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$ and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated $k_0$-schemes of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $g_0:Y_0\to X_0$ be a finite étale $k_0$-morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $g:Y\to X$ be its geometric fibre over $k$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a lisse Weil sheaf on $Y_0$: a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf $(\mathcal F,\theta)$ on $Y_0$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] whose underlying sheaf on $Y$ is a lisse $\Qlb$-sheaf [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Then the direct image $g_*\mathcal F=Rg_*\mathcal F$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with the Weil structure of its equivariant lift [prop-weil-operations], is a lisse Weil sheaf on $X_0$ in the same sense: a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf on $X_0$ whose underlying sheaf on $X$ is a lisse $\Qlb$-sheaf.
